title: How Frame Generation Creates In-Between Frames
description:
Frame generation analyses consecutive rendered frames and motion evidence, then synthesises an intermediate image. This short animation separates displayed smoothness from game simulation, input sampling, frame pacing and the artefacts that can appear when the source evidence is weak.

Sources:
https://gpuopen.com/manuals/fidelityfx_sdk/techniques/super-resolution-interpolation/
https://gpuopen.com/amd-fsr-framegeneration/
https://developer.nvidia.com/rtx/dlss

Visuals: original Pulse Gaming diagrams.
Narration: locally generated British synthetic voice.
Music: original Pulse Gaming synthesis.
Synthetic media disclosure: Yes.
